name: National Family Benefit Scheme
summary: A family welfare scheme under the umbrella scheme ‘National Social Assistance Programme’ (NSAP) by MoRD. In this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the bereaved households in case of the death of the primary breadwinner irrespective of the cause of death.
benefits: ₹ 20000/ - will be given as a lump sum assistance to such surviving member of the household of the deceased poor, who after local inquiry, is found to be the head of the household.
benefits_evidence: ₹ 20000/ - will be given as a lump sum assistance to such surviving member of the household of the deceased poor, who after local inquiry, is found to be the head of the household.

rules.reason: The family of the applicant must be living Below Poverty Line (BPL)

rules.reason: The primary breadwinner of the applicant's family must have been deceased
rules.evidence: The primary breadwinner of the applicant's family must have been deceased.

rules.reason: The earning member must have been older than 18 when they died
rules.evidence: The age of the deceased breadwinner must have been more than 18 years and less than 60 years.

rules.reason: The earning member must have been younger than 60 when they died

how_to_apply: Offline or Online. Take a print of the application form given in Annexure-III (page no. 47) of the scheme guidelines - https://nsap.nic.in/Guidelines/nsap_guidelines_oct2014.pdf. The duly filled-in Application forms along with the required documents are to be submitted to the designated officer appointed by the respective state governments.
